HARBOR LANE PARTNERS | PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL
PROJECT FALCON: PROCESS UPDATE (DRAFT v3, do not forward)

To: Falcon deal team
Cc: Maya (compliance)
From: Dan
Date: 2026-10-22
Re: Where we are on Falcon and what we need before the LOI

1. Status
Corvane Freight Holdings ("Corvane", our client) signed the NDA with Nimbus Logistics on 2026-10-06. Management meeting with the Nimbus CEO and CFO was held in Memphis on 2026-10-15. Corvane's investment committee approved a non-binding range of 9.0x to 9.75x LTM EBITDA on 2026-10-20.

2. Proposed terms (for discussion, not yet agreed with Corvane)
- Price: $38.50 per NMBL share in cash, a ~24% premium to the 2026-10-21 close of $31.05.
- Implied EV ~$1.35bn, ~9.5x LTM EBITDA of $142m.
- Exclusivity: 45 days from LOI signing.
- Break fee: 3% of equity value. [Dan: Corvane GC wants 2.5%, discuss Fri]
- No financing condition. Corvane has committed financing from its lenders for up to $1.1bn.

3. Diligence workstreams
- Quality of earnings: Ashby & Rowe, kickoff the week after the LOI.
- Customer concentration: top customer ~22% of revenue, contract renews 2027-03-31. We want a call with that customer before signing (Nimbus will resist).
- Labor: Memphis hub union contract expires 2027-06-30.
- Real estate: 3 of 11 hubs are on leases that roll in 2027.

4. Timeline
- LOI to the Nimbus board by 2026-10-28 (their board meets 2026-10-29).
- Target signing mid-December. Announce alongside Nimbus Q4 results if we can, otherwise standalone.
- Earnout: dropped, Corvane hates it. [TODO: confirm the model no longer has it]

5. Wall
Maya keeps the Falcon wall list. Nimbus Logistics went on the restricted list on 2026-10-06. Do NOT discuss Falcon on #hl-floor or with research or the desk.
